explication: fooyin is a customizable desktop music player. The principal workflow is: a user selects library or playlist tracks, the player controller requests a change, EngineHandler dispatches it to AudioEngine, decoding produces streams, AudioPipeline renders them through DSP and sends audio to the selected output device. Library, playlists, scripting, conversion, artwork, verification, plugins, and visualisation are adjacent capabilities. Several peripheral implementations were not sampled, so their nodes are retained from the documented tree and README without speculative wiring.
